name: card
title: Raqt card
description: Raqt card, the surface primitive every other container inherits from. Slots: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter. A card nested inside another card automatically steps up one elevation and down one radius — no prop needed; `level` (1-3) overrides it for a surface that only reads as nested, such as a popover panel. `interactive` adds hover and focus affordances for a card that is itself a control. Use it for any panel, tile or grouped block.
